summary: Implemented CLOSE-2: pure lifecycle derivation, ClosurePanel and useCaseLifecycle mounted on CaseBoardPage, confirmed close/reopen with closedAt preserved when edits break readiness, shelf readiness badges, and 19 unit/component tests plus a 3-viewport Playwright closure journey; all required checks pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented CLOSE-2: pure lifecycle derivation, ClosurePanel and useCaseLifecycle mounted on CaseBoardPage, confirmed close/reopen with closedAt preserved when edits break readiness, shelf readiness badges, and 19 unit/component tests plus a 3-viewport Playwright closure journey; all required checks pass.
decisions: Readiness remains derived on every repository read; CaseSummary carries it only as a non-persisted projection.
Re-affirming closure of an already closed case preserves the original closedAt.
Repairing a closed case re-enables Close while leaving the case closed; it never auto-reopens.
Loose-thread rows link to card detail and expose a separate 'Show on board' action for centering without leaving the board.
Phone closure is a stacked, sheet-like surface; modal-sheet refinement is deferred to responsive hardening.
interfaces: ClosurePanel({caseRecord, readiness, busy, error, onCloseCase, onReopenCase, cardHref, onShowCard, onClearError})
CaseSummary now includes readiness: 'ready' | 'loose' and looseThreadCount: number
agentReportedTests: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/closure.spec.ts: 3 passed (desktop, tablet-landscape, phone)
warnings: Phone closure panel is not a modal sheet yet; responsive hardening may require revisiting it.
Loose-thread ordering follows readiness title order, not the shelf's createdAt order.
validationLimitations: Spatial board placement and canvas gestures were not exercised; the closure journey uses the keyboard card list and capture route for graph repair.
payload.taskDescription: Create ClosurePanel and useCaseLifecycle. Mount the panel on CaseBoardPage. Show readiness, loose-thread rows with links, and a Close action disabled until the count is zero. Closing writes closedAt through CaseRepository after confirmation. Render Closed and Reopen for a closed case; if edits break readiness, render Closed · loose threads without clearing closedAt. Reopen asks for confirmation and clears closedAt. Extend case summaries with loose-thread count and readiness for the shelf badge. Add component tests for every state and a Playwright journey that closes a complete case, adds a loose note, sees the warning, repairs it, and reopens. Do not add topic badges.
